name: Arashiyama
heritage: Historic Site of Japan; Place of Scenic Beauty
text: Arashiyama (嵐山, Storm Mountain) is a district on the western outskirts of Kyoto, Japan. It also refers to the mountain across the Ōi River, which forms a backdrop to the district. Arashiyama is a nationally designated historic site and place of scenic beauty.

depictions.name: Arashiyama
depictions.text: Arashiyama (嵐山, Storm Mountain) is a district on the western outskirts of Kyoto, Japan. It also refers to the mountain across the Katsura River, which forms a backdrop to the district. During the Sengoku period, Arashiyama had yet to be integrated into Kyoto, being considered its own sub-region of Yamashiro, and was not as densely populated.
